## 👨🏽‍💻 A little about me

I'm a developer and product designer who enjoys turning ideas into useful digital experiences. I care about how a product looks, how it works, and—most importantly—whether it solves a real problem for the people using it.

- 🚀 Building **BuildUp**, a work-identity platform for job seekers and artisans in Nigeria.
- 🎨 Designing interfaces, wireframes, prototypes, and product experiences with Figma.
- 💻 Building responsive web experiences with React, Vue, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- 📱 Exploring mobile product development with React Native and Expo.
- 🤝 Open to freelance projects, contract roles, collaborations, and interesting ideas.

> **My approach:** Understand the problem → Design the experience → Build the product → Learn and improve.

## 🚀 Selected projects

### 🟣 BuildUp — Work identity for Nigeria
A product I'm building to help job seekers and artisans present their skills and work identity, and connect with opportunities.

**Focus:** Product strategy · UX · Marketplace thinking · React · Supabase

### 💬 DevChat — Real-time chat
A real-time chat application built with React, Vite, and Firebase/Firestore.

**Stack:** React · Vite · Firebase · Firestore

🔗 **[Open DevChat](https://chat-app-for-devs.vercel.app)**

### 🤝 BizConnect — Business ledger
A vendor and retailer ledger application with a custom neomorphic interface.

**Stack:** Vue 3 · Tailwind CSS

🔗 **[Open BizConnect](https://bizconnect-kappa.vercel.app)**

### 💸 Budget Tracker — Personal finance
A lightweight personal finance tracker designed around Naira-based income and expense tracking.

**Stack:** HTML · Tailwind CSS · JavaScript

🔗 **[Open Budget Tracker](https://budget-trac-ten.vercel.app)**

### 🎓 EduLife Hub — Campus management
Collaborated on a campus management application for FUNAAB, built with React Native and Expo, including a campus landmark map experience.

**Stack:** React Native · Expo · TypeScript · Expo Router · Google Maps
